```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 << 'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

NOTES = Path("content/english/notes")
HUB_OLD = "Hub: [[21 Laws of Leadership in the Bible]] - lesson"
HUB_NEW_SUFFIX = "; horizontal frame in [[Leadership]]."

CONTRADICTS_BLOCK = """  - type: contradicts
    wikilink: "[[Discipleship vs Leadership]]"
    reason: "when horizontal technique substitutes for upward allegiance"
"""

for path in sorted(NOTES.glob("law-of*.md")):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    orig = text

    # Hub line: add Leadership wikilink
    text = re.sub(
        r"(Hub: \[\[21 Laws of Leadership in the Bible\]\] - lesson \d+ of twenty-one Bible) leadership laws\.",
        r"\1 laws" + HUB_NEW_SUFFIX,
        text,
    )

    # Add contradicts if missing
    if "type: contradicts" not in text:
        text = text.replace(
            "relationships:\n  - type: extends",
            "relationships:\n" + CONTRADICTS_BLOCK + "  - type: extends",
            1,
        )

    if text != orig:
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        print("updated", path.name)

# empowerment
p = NOTES / "law-of-empowerment.md"
t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
t2 = t.replace(
    "Jesus sent the twelve with authority",
    "Jesus sent [[Invest in the Few]] with authority",
)
if t2 != t:
    p.write_text(t2, encoding="utf-8")
    print("updated law-of-empowerment twelve")

# priorities
p = NOTES / "law-of-priorities.md"
t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
t2 = t.replace(

    "  - **Acts 6 - Tables Served, Word Ministry Central** - Seven appointed to tables so [[Invest in the Few]] stayed on prayer and word.",
)
if t2 != t:
    p.write_text(t2, encoding="utf-8")
    print("updated law-of-priorities twelve")
```

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 << 'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
import yaml

NOTES = Path("content/english/notes")
SKIP = {"_index.md"}
LEVEL_RE = re.compile(r"(?m)^\s*-\s+Level\s+([1-5]):\s")

def load_fm(path):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if not text.startswith("---"):
        return None, text
    end = text.find("\n---", 3)
    if end == -1:
        return None, text
    fm = yaml.safe_load(text[3:end]) or {}
    return fm, text

missing = []
no_key_concept = []
complete = []
exempt = []

for path in sorted(NOTES.glob("*.md")):
    if path.name in SKIP:
        continue
    fm, _ = load_fm(path)
    if fm is None:
        continue
    title = fm.get("title", path.stem)
    note_kind = fm.get("note_kind", "note")
    kc = fm.get("key_concept")
    if not kc or not str(kc).strip():
        no_key_concept.append((path.name, title, note_kind))
        continue
    kc_text = str(kc)
    found = {int(m.group(1)) for m in LEVEL_RE.finditer(kc_text)}
    missing_levels = [n for n in range(1, 6) if n not in found]
    if missing_levels:
        missing.append({
            "file": path.name,
            "title": title,
            "note_kind": note_kind,
            "found": sorted(found),
            "missing": missing_levels,
        })
    else:
        complete.append(path.name)

print(f"COMPLETE (all 5 levels): {len(complete)}")
print(f"MISSING levels: {len(missing)}")
print(f"NO key_concept: {len(no_key_concept)}")
print()

if missing:
    print("=== MISSING LEVELS ===")
    for row in missing:
        print(f"{row['title']} ({row['file']}) [{row['note_kind']}]")
        print(f"  found: {row['found'] or 'none'}")
        print(f"  missing: {row['missing']}")
        print()

if no_key_concept:
    print("=== NO key_concept ===")
    for fname, title, nk in no_key_concept:
        print(f"  {title} ({fname}) [{nk}]")
PY
```

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 << 'PY'
import re
from pathlib import Path
import yaml

NOTES = Path("content/english/notes")
SKIP = {"_index.md"}
LEVEL_RE = re.compile(r"(?m)^\s*-\s+Level\s+([1-5]):\s")

missing = []
for path in sorted(NOTES.glob("*.md")):
    if path.name in SKIP:
        continue
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if not text.startswith("---"):
        continue
    end = text.find("\n---", 3)
    fm = yaml.safe_load(text[3:end]) or {}
    kc = fm.get("key_concept")
    if not kc or not str(kc).strip():
        continue
    found = {int(m.group(1)) for m in LEVEL_RE.finditer(str(kc))}
    miss = [n for n in range(1, 6) if n not in found]
    if miss:
        missing.append((fm.get("title", path.stem), path.name, miss))

print(f"Notes with key_concept: {len(list(NOTES.glob('*.md'))) - 1}")
print(f"Missing levels: {len(missing)}")
if missing:
    for t, f, m in missing:
        print(f"  {t} ({f}): missing {m}")
else:
    print("All notes with key_concept have Level 1 through Level 5.")
```
